title: Gluten-Free Indian-Style Burger
description: A flavorful and healthy twist on the classic burger, featuring an Indian-inspired patty and toppings.

ingredients.name: Juicy Burger Patty
ingredients.notes: Made with ground meat and Indian spices

instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Form the juicy burger patty and grill for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked to your liking.
3. Meanwhile, toast the garlic naan buns on the grill or in a toaster.
4. Stir-fry the onions with Indian spices until softened and fragrant.
5. Assemble the burger by spreading mint chutney on the bottom bun, followed by the burger patty, stir-fried onions, and any desired toppings.
